mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.meeting_id, p.content, p.image_url, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.create_time FROM post AS p WHERE p.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND p.status = 0 AND p.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
